candidates2h.note: forecast = hourly forecast from the model run about 5 to 11 h before the event; satellite = the scan 135 min before the event (what the app holds 120 min out), carried forward; blend = the mean of the two scores

outlook.note: the forecast's score cut at 45 (Good or better against Fair or Poor), against each event's percentile on its own cam

tune.input: satellite read from the scan 20 min before the event

afterItShipped.note: per-cam minimum is 8 pairs; with 6 days no cam reaches it

skyTypes.note: mean of each event's percentile on its own cam (0 = that cam's dullest, 1 = its best); 0.5 is average

families.family: clear-sky value only (is there a sweet spot?)
path cost only (low cloud toward the sun)
